title: AskLocal: AI-search visibility reports in Swedish, Romanian and German for small SEO agencies
source: Top 50 research (Nov 2026): reframed from ideas dropped from the Top 25 report, plus new web research
summary: Clients now ask their SEO agency "do we show up in ChatGPT?". Most AI-visibility tools track English prompts for big brands. AskLocal tracks real local-language questions for small local and B2B businesses and turns the results into a white-label monthly report the agency can sell.
hook: "My clients keep asking if they appear in ChatGPT. I have no way to show them, in Swedish, for the questions their customers actually ask."
story:
**Linnea runs a 3-person SEO agency in Örebro** with **25 local clients**: dentists, plumbers, accountants, a furniture shop. Several clients saw Google clicks drop and ask whether ChatGPT and Google's AI answers mention them when someone asks **"bästa rörmokaren i Örebro"**.

The AI-visibility tools she tried are built for big brands, price per prompt, and work best in English. Linnea wants to track **20 local questions per client in Swedish**, see which competitors the AI names instead, get a short to-do list (reviews, structured data, local pages), and send a branded report every month as a paid add-on.
whyNow: Clicks from Google fall when AI answers appear, and agencies need a new service to sell. AI referrals are still small, so the honest product is a monitoring-and-advice add-on, not a traffic promise.
evidence: Ahrefs found a 58% drop in top-position click-through rate for keywords that trigger AI Overviews (Dec 2025) [PPC Land]
A study of 16,661 sites found Google organic clicks down 21.8% year on year in August 2026 [SEOcrawl]
AI assistants still send only about 1% of traffic across industries, and ChatGPT sends roughly 75–83% of AI referrals [Digitaleer citing Conductor / SEOcrawl]
83 AI-visibility (GEO) tools were counted in 2026, and Shopify GEO apps start from $9/month [eCommerce Fastlane / Shopify App Store]

whyReal.title: Agencies need something new to sell
whyReal.text: As organic clicks fall, SEO agencies need a service that answers clients' AI questions and justifies retainers.

whyReal.title: Local language is the narrow gap
whyReal.text: Most tools focus on English prompts and big brands. Small local businesses in Sweden, Romania or Germany are asked about in their own language.

whyReal.title: Honest weakness
whyReal.text: AI-visibility tools were dropped from the Top 25 because the market is very crowded and measurement is noisy. This version only works as a cheap, local, white-label add-on.

whyReal.title: Victor's skills fit
whyReal.text: Prompt tracking, parsing answers and writing AI summaries is pure LLM engineering.

whoPays.label: Customer
whoPays.text: Small SEO and local-marketing agencies (1–20 staff) with local or small B2B clients.

whoPays.label: Start market
whoPays.text: Sweden and Romania (founders' languages), then Germany, Poland and other non-English markets.

solution.title: Client setup
solution.text: the agency adds a client, its city, services and main competitors; AskLocal suggests 20 typical local questions in the local language.

solution.title: Weekly checks
solution.text: AskLocal asks those questions to ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity APIs and records which businesses are mentioned and how.

solution.title: Visibility score
solution.text: a simple share-of-mentions score per client and competitor, tracked over time.

solution.title: Fix list
solution.text: checks the client's website structured data, Google Business Profile basics and review counts, and lists concrete actions.

solution.title: White-label report
solution.text: a branded monthly PDF or link in the local language for the agency to send.

must: Weekly prompt runs on 2–3 AI APIs
later: Google AI Overviews tracking via a search API

risks.risk: AI answers are noisy and change daily
risks.answer: Show trends over several runs, not single answers; be honest in reports.

risks.risk: API costs grow with every client
risks.answer: Price per client tier; limit questions; cache runs.
Treat as a cheap add-on agencies resell at a markup, not a core service.

questions: Do your clients ask about ChatGPT or Google AI answers? How often?
What do you deliver to them today on this topic?
Which tools have you tried, and why did or didn't you keep them?
Would you resell a monthly AI-visibility report under your brand? At what price?
Which local questions would matter most for your typical client?
